name: DTR mobile context
query: SELECT payload->'event_data'->>'run_id' AS run_id,payload->'event_data'->>'revision' AS revision,payload->'event_data'->>'stage' AS stage,payload->'event_data'->>'destination' AS destination,payload->'event_data'->>'hotel_name' AS hotel_name,payload->'event_data'->>'hotel_id' AS hotel_id,payload->'event_data'->>'marketing' AS marketing,COALESCE((payload->'event_data'->>'net_booking')::numeric,0) AS net_booking,COALESCE((payload->'event_data'->>'net_value')::numeric,0) AS net_value,COALESCE((payload->'event_data'->>'ancillary_value')::numeric,0) AS ancillary_value,payload->'event_data'->>'checked_in' AS checked_in,payload->'event_data'->>'watch_active' AS watch_active,payload->'event_data'->>'service_case' AS service_case,event_time AS updated_at FROM events WHERE event_type_id='4572680a-c44c-4b72-86d2-1ddb61e76dd5' AND payload->'event_data'->>'demo_site'='dertour_mobile' ORDER BY event_time DESC,received_at DESC LIMIT 1
